delegated_task_summary: Mission Control: triage the 43 deep failures into four residual classes and flag runtime/session validation as highest priority for immediate bounded repair. GMUT evidence matrix: cross-map the 43 standard failures against the four residual classes to identify which failures are agent-council-validation versus expansion-gate-sync-bridge related, producing a compact evidence table. Suite residual repair: target one quick win in runtime/session validation by isolating a single reproducible failure pattern and proposing a minimal patch that requires no external auth or paid cloud resources.
gmut_note: V49 suite shows stable pass rates across standard and deep (1112/1117 pass, 43 fail), indicating the residual class taxonomy is accurate and repairable; the bounded approach is to not chase all 43 but to prove one fix pattern that can be replicated across the class.
bounded_limits: No direct repo writes by the candidate.
